limitations: No live QA HTTP request or complete HTTP response body/headers was captured. Actual commands pin 8192 output/high, and the provider probe accepts 8192/adaptive/high; live solver request bodies cannot be independently replay-inspected. Terminal modelUsage.maxOutputTokens=32000 is reported model-capability metadata, not evidence of the actual request cap. Total session output can exceed a per-request limit.
Terminal result.usage and modelUsage agree and are complete. Assistant usage events are partial (zero cache/output fields) and are not used for complete accounting.

Frozen source inventory and runtime inventory are fully rehashed from their public manifests and cross-checked with the frozen dataset. Post-trial source invariance is supported by readonly mounts and the pinned runner rehash report; no separate post-trial file inventory or source bytes are uploaded for an independent physical rehash.

Private grant/signing-key/home/index seed files are intentionally absent from public artifacts. Baseline seed isolation follows pinned code, distinct fresh-home/index mounts, no embedding environment names and actual init with no MCP; private seed contents cannot be independently re-inspected.
Secret scans concern configured credential values known to the runner, not an exhaustive guarantee about unknown secrets; no secret values were accessed by this audit.

Remote model/catalog/index identity is verified at the recorded configuration level, not an immutable provider weight revision. Remote embedding HTTP requests/tokens/billing and separate query network-only latency are not available.

Actual correct-root MCP successes establish retrieval execution, not answer quality, source support, or usefulness. Shared instruction inclusion does not establish an internal self-check was performed or caused any result.
Agent wall includes query-time embedding/network waits. Grant/index/preflight are separate measured setup; no install/build total or cold end-to-end speedup is claimed.
Answers were hashed and matched mechanically to terminal result bytes; their semantic content, blind grades and arm mappings were not reviewed. No quality or efficiency verdict is computed.
